contract: Только канонические флаги; legacy-алиасы удалены. Unknown flag => code 4.
readers: bootstrap.ps1 reads this file through installer/lib/flags.ps1 and forwards flags unchanged
install.ps1 and scripts/all.ps1 forwarders read it through installer/lib/flags.ps1
installer/install.ps1 trusts the already-parsed flag set; it never re-implements validation
exit_codes_note: Code 5 / DELIVERY added; code 2 redefined as BLOCK (not delivery). Before installer/install.ps1 is available => 5; after it exists but the invocation is broken => 4.

exit_codes_detail.2: BLOCK: missing prerequisite or human action; not delivery
exit_codes_detail.5: DELIVERY: source/assets not delivered before installer/install.ps1 exists
exit_codes_detail.4_vs_5_boundary: before orchestrator is available => 5; after it exists, broken invocation => 4
